semiconductor_relevance: High — SEIREN Advanced Materials is directly involved in the production of semiconductor substrates, including SOI and SiC wafers, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: SEIREN Advanced Materials specializes in the production and processing of semiconductor substrates, focusing on Silicon on Insulator (SOI) and Silicon Carbide (SiC) wafers. They offer a range of customized wafer sizes and specifications, catering to specific customer needs in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Production of SOI wafers using thick film thermal oxide technology
Manufacturing of SiC wafers for power devices and LED applications
Film coating services for in-stock and customer-supplied substrates
Customization of substrates for optical communications and semiconductor applications
